title: Jan mayjtʼir Pacientejja
intro: Profecianakan sarnaqäwinakapatxa, jukʼanikiw ukham jachʼa chhaqtäwinaksa ukat janchi tuqit tʼaqhisiñanaksa jan mayjtʼir iyawsäwimpi aguantapxi. Aka chimpun sarnaqäwipax paciencia ukat Diosan yatiñapar atinisiñ tuqit jan pachani yatichäwiwa. ¿Khitis aka almaxa?
clues: Nayax Allah jupan ajllitätwa mä yatiyäw yatiyañataki, ukampis jach’a yant’äwix janiw jan iyawsäwimp jutkänti, jan ukasti sapa mayni jan walt’äwinakampiw jutäna.
Qam yänakajasa, uywanakajasa, wawanakajasa, maynit maynikamaw nayat apsutäna.
Cuerpojajj usuchjatänwa, ukat chachaja jan ukajj warmijan yanaptʼatapat sipansa sapakiw qheparayäta.
Nayax Tatitujaruw art’asiyäta, t’aqhisiñanakax uñt’ayasa ukat khuyapayasiñap thaqhasa.
Nayarojj kayujampiw oraqer chʼalltʼañama sasaw sapjjetäna, ukat mä samarañ uma jalsuw mistunïna.
Allah jupax k’umaräñajaruw kutt’ayawayitu ukat machaq familia ukat nayrat sipans juk’amp qamirïñ churitu.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
